paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the training loss of a preference model over training steps. The y-axis, labeled "Training Loss", has a linear scale with a value range from 0 to 14 and is in unspecified units. The y-axis tick labels are spaced at intervals of 2, starting from 0 and ending at 14. The x-axis, labeled "Training Step", has a linear scale with a value range from 0 to approximately 950 and is in unspecified units. The x-axis tick labels are spaced at intervals of 200, starting from 0 and ending at 1200. The plot contains a single blue line with no markers, representing the training loss of the preference model. The line starts at approximately 13.5 at a training step of 0 and sharply decreases to around 0.2 at a training step of 50, then remains steady at approximately 0.1 from a training step of 100 to 1200.
